description: This PHP source file defines the class SchedulersViewList, which extends ViewList, and overrides its display method to add additional behavior related to showing cron instructions if a certain option is not set to false. It appears to be part of the view layer for listing scheduled tasks or cron jobs within the SuiteCRM module for schedulers.

classes.name: SchedulersViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for displaying a list of scheduled tasks, extends the base ViewList class and adds functionality for displaying cron instructions based on options

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to add behavior for showing cron instructions unless suppressed by options
